correctness.rationale: Full equality and 27 possible ternary atoms on an ordered triple reduce exactly to nine modular congruence indicators after translating first element to 0; independent direct atomic generation checks these encodings. In the EF three-round back-and-forth recursion, a pair (0,d) is classified by the set of its third-variable diagrams, and the structure by the collection of pair profiles. For n>=9, nontrivial flags require t in {0,d,-d,2d} plus roots of 2t=0,2d,d, giving <=8 exceptional points and at least one generic witness. Coincidence/solvability classification depends only on parity n, min(5,ord d), and 2-divisibility d; eleven pair profiles and allowed patterns depend exactly on 2,3,4,8 divisibility, hence gcd(n,24). The small n=2..8 classes and fourteen pairwise distinct representative profiles were checked against the actual nine-bit certificate. An original separate computation directly enumerated all 27 atomic ternary relations for n=2..120 and recovered exactly fourteen classes. The finite range corroborates the explicit modular overlap argument and does not prove it by itself.
